newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Sentron a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Thermo Sentron a buy.

text.p: Miller, Johnson & Kuehn Inc said Friday it initiated coverage with a buy rating of Thermo Sentron Inc, which provides high-speed precision weighing and inspection equipment used for quality control.
Thermo Sentron is expected to benefit from consumer protection legislation for product quality, it said in a research report.
Miller, Johnson estimates Thermo Sentron's 1997 yearend earnings at $0.73 a share and 1998 yearend earnings at $0.88. In 1996, the Minneapolis-based company reported earnings of $0.56.
Shares of Thermo Sentron closed off 2/16 to 11-1/16.
